items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: In fact, all of them was good musicians. I played with them. After I went back to Leclerc in 1913, I played with them.

ctx.x: He's still here. He's still here.
He's still here. So I was here. In fact, all of them was good musicians. I played with them. After I went back to Leclerc in 1913, I played with them. Do they have many bands around Leclerc?

items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1958-11-26
items.q: I believe he was the first man that I know that had a slide, brought a slide here from Lutcher in Yard.

ctx.x: We would like to talk to him. Oh, he lived.

That's his nephew for the afternoon. And you think he was the first one that brought the slide then? I believe he was the first man that I know that had a slide, brought a slide here from Lutcher in Yard.
Oh, where did you get your saxophone? My saxophone?
